_comment: VULNERABLE POLICY — FOR EDUCATIONAL USE ONLY
_risk: This policy grants public read access to the entire bucket. Anyone on the internet can read every object.
_attack_vector: An attacker enumerating S3 buckets finds this bucket is public. No AWS credentials are required. Data exfiltration requires only a standard HTTP GET request.
_detection_gap: S3 public access does not generate IAM CloudTrail events. The download appears as unauthenticated S3 data events, which require S3 data event logging to be enabled — often it is not.

Statement._sid_note: The Sid name is misleading — 'PublicReadAccess' sounds intentional but is almost always a misconfiguration
Statement._principal_note: Wildcard principal: grants access to any entity, authenticated or not, on the internet
Statement._resource_note: Wildcard on resource path: every object in the bucket is exposed
